title: Salsa Orchestra
description: Kick off the festival with high-energy Cuban rhythms and infectious grooves from the Royal Birmingham Conservatoire Salsa Orchestra.

title: Tony Levin Drum Prize - Jean Toussaint
description: Celebrating the legacy of the legendary drummer Tony Levin. Finalists compete for the prize, accompanied by Art Blakey alumnus and saxophonist Jean Toussaint and bassist Arnie Somogyi.

title: MILES DAVIS BOOK LAUNCH
description: Launch event for 'Rethinking Miles Davis'. This new book challenges the orthodoxy of jazz criticism, repositioning Davis within a larger framework of modernism and mass culture.

title: RJ Gilbert
description: An intimate set showcasing original compositions and contemporary improvisation from the rising RBC talent.

title: Ben Lewsis Skeath
description: Expect a blend of melodic invention and rhythmic interplay in this showcase performance.

title: Digbeth Jazz - Dave Sear Sextet
description: Trombonist and composer Dave Sear leads his sextet. Known for his warm tone and intricate writing, Sear brings a set of contemporary jazz that balances melody with driving energy.

title: Poppy Baker
description: A spotlight performance featuring one of the conservatoire's emerging jazz voices.

title: Rachel Towner
description: Exploring the intersections of jazz tradition and modern song-writing.

title: Jazz Orch Porgy and Bess
description: The RBC Jazz Orchestra celebrates the Miles Davis centenary year with a performance of the complete 'Porgy and Bess' suite, featuring the iconic arrangements of Gil Evans.

title: Joe Nobel
description: The National Youth Jazz Collective presents the next generation of UK jazz talent in a collaborative performance.

title: Indo Jazz Fusion
description: A mesmerizing synthesis of Indian classical ragas and Western jazz improvisation, creating a unique cross-cultural soundscape.

title: Jamie Mcleish Hammond Jam
description: A grooving, Hammond organ-led jam session. Expect funk, soul-jazz, and high-energy improvisation.

title: Chris Potter and Pablo Held Trio
description: HEADLINE EVENT: A trans-Atlantic meeting of musical minds. US saxophone giant Chris Potter joins forces with Europe's leading piano trio, led by Pablo Held, for a night of world-class interplay.

title: Festivals in Focus Symposium
description: A day of panels and discussion on the future of jazz festivals. Opening presentation by Prof George McKay (UEA): '20 years of festivals research in the UK'.

title: BCU Voices/Eastside Voices/Blowout
description: The university's premier vocal ensemble explores the voice in a jazz context, from close harmony to choral improvisation, followed by performances from Eastside Voices and student band Blowout.

title: Senior Student Double Bill
description: Two of the Conservatoire's finest final-year talents, Ben Shankland and Macy Wright, present their own bands and original material.

title: Freddie Dal
description: An exciting set from up-and-coming talent Freddie Dal.

title: Josh Bailey
description: Josh Bailey

title: BJO (Birmingham Jazz Orchestra)
description: Birmingham's premier contemporary big band returns, performing ambitious new works and arrangements by local composers.

title: Ben Pond
description: RBC student Ben Pond takes the stage for an hour of small-group jazz.

title: Rebecca Nash Trio (Aurum Trio)
description: Pianist Rebecca Nash is joined by Henrik Jensen and Dave Smith. 'Aurum' is a bold statement of intent—a project where raw energy and deep musicality collide.

title: Marcus Coates
description: Marcus Coates

title: TDE Promo - Olie Brice Quartet
description: Avant-garde and improvised music at its best. Featuring Alexander Hawkins (piano), Rachel Musson (tenor sax), Olie Brice (bass), and Will Glaser (drums).

title: RBC Youth Jazz
description: The Junior Conservatoire jazz ensemble showcases the stars of tomorrow.

title: Digbeth Jam
description: The festival's signature jam session. A chance for students, staff, and guests to share the stage in a spontaneous celebration of jazz.

title: Jamie Mcleish Hammond Jam
description: The second installment of the Hammond organ jam—expect things to get funky as the evening sets in.

title: BBC Big Band
description: Widely regarded as one the world's leading and most versatile Jazz Orchestras, the BBC Big Band continues to delight audiences with their immense power and precision.
